debrief.transcript: Okay so today was mixed. I did do the deep work block on the app, two hours, no phone, which honestly felt great. Then in the afternoon I caught myself sketching a completely new business idea instead of finishing the onboarding flow. Classic me. Skipped the run because it rained and I used that as an excuse. Had a good call with my brother though, we haven't talked in weeks. Energy is decent but I stayed up too late again last night.
